title: Settings
subtitle: Personalize your training experience — changes are saved automatically
dataHint: Export, import or clear training data
dataScopeNote: Export is a complete backup (hands included). Import validates every record and skips duplicates.
exportComplete: Exported {{count}} training records and your settings
exportPartial: Hand history could not be read — exported a partial backup (records and settings only)
exportFailed: Export failed: could not build the backup file
importSummary: Import finished: {{added}} added, {{duplicate}} duplicates, {{invalid}} invalid, {{failed}} not saved
importInvalid: Invalid file format: no usable training records or settings found
importHandsFailed: Records were applied as summarized above, but hand history data failed to restore
developerHint: Debug unlock all features (course levels, positions, learning tracks & daily question limit)
debugUnlocked: Debug unlock active · All features unlocked
clearConfirmDesc: Only training records (the statistics and history lists) are deleted. ELO ranks, review queue, settings, academy progress and hand history data are kept. This cannot be undone.
clearFailed: Clear failed: records are still stored locally (rolled back). Please retry later.
